contentSyncTriggers: CREATE TRIGGER IF NOT EXISTS room_fts_content_sync_collections_fts_BEFORE_UPDATE BEFORE UPDATE ON `collections` BEGIN DELETE FROM `collections_fts` WHERE `docid`=OLD.`rowid`; END
CREATE TRIGGER IF NOT EXISTS room_fts_content_sync_collections_fts_BEFORE_DELETE BEFORE DELETE ON `collections` BEGIN DELETE FROM `collections_fts` WHERE `docid`=OLD.`rowid`; END

CREATE TRIGGER IF NOT EXISTS room_fts_content_sync_collections_fts_AFTER_UPDATE AFTER UPDATE ON `collections` BEGIN INSERT INTO `collections_fts`(`docid`, `businessName`, `physicalAddress`, `county`, `agentId`, `originCounty`, `personName`, `nationality`) VALUES (NEW.`rowid`, NEW.`businessName`, NEW.`physicalAddress`, NEW.`county`, NEW.`agentId`, NEW.`originCounty`, NEW.`personName`, NEW.`nationality`); END

CREATE TRIGGER IF NOT EXISTS room_fts_content_sync_collections_fts_AFTER_INSERT AFTER INSERT ON `collections` BEGIN INSERT INTO `collections_fts`(`docid`, `businessName`, `physicalAddress`, `county`, `agentId`, `originCounty`, `personName`, `nationality`) VALUES (NEW.`rowid`, NEW.`businessName`, NEW.`physicalAddress`, NEW.`county`, NEW.`agentId`, NEW.`originCounty`, NEW.`personName`, NEW.`nationality`); END
